name: debate-platform
description: MERN debate judging platform with Organizer, Judge and Participant dashboards

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
